profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: An experienced software engineer with a passion for web technologies and innovation. Has delivered many software projects for both public and private organizations.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Mr. Gomez was hired as a consultant to lead the development of the California Department of Motor Vehicle's modernization initiatives. This included technical architecture development, application development, API development, system integration, code reviews, and mentoring other developers with best practice.

He successfully led numerous projects through the full software development lifecycle, which included gathering project requirements, collaborating with project managers and executives, leading a development team, and delivering the final product to Production.

These projects included various ETL systems and a suite of Web Applications and Cloud Services that enabled the DMV to host mobile events where Californians could apply for a REAL ID card. 

He also contributed to the development of the agency’s online Driver License and ID application system, which included enhancements to the user interfaces and back-end systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Mr. Gomez started his time at Cambria Solutions as part of the Solution Center team building prototype applications and proof-of-concepts. The core technical stack used was React with Redux and Node.js, and deployed to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

After his time with this team, he was assigned to the Child Welfare Digital Services to develop React applications that support child welfare and social workers. His main responsibilities included developing user interfaces using React with Redux and developing back-end services in Ruby on Rails.

He helped build applications using Agile methodologies and test-driven development, which helped the team iterate quickly and continuously deliver functionality.

When the contract was completed, he transitioned into consulting as a Lead Developer at the California Department of Motor Vehicles. He led the development of the agency’s modernization and innovation initiatives, which included the development of custom web applications and cloud services.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Mr. Gomez contributed to the development of a web-based fantasy sports game called Spoker.com. His main responsibilities for the project included adding new features to the game, as well to debug existing features. He was responsible for enhancing and developing user interfaces, back-end services to process game play data, and SQL queries to store game play data.

He was also involved in the development of Cazab.com, a car donation website. His main responsibilities for this project included website maintenance, content updates, automating jobs to send emails to clients, as well as creating a new administration system and buyer portal. He also integrated Twilio’s SMS platform into the system, created an invoice management system, as well as a Buyer portal for Cazab’s affiliates.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Mr. Gomez was responsible for the development of custom Windows applications, Web applications, and Android applications. He utilized Visual Studio, ASP.NET, SQL Server, and IIS. His responsibilities included all aspects of the software development lifecycle, including gathering requirements, working with project managers, and driving delivery of the product to end-users.

He also developed several Android applications that involved NFC, the camera, uploading to a SFTP server, and writing records to a SQL database. The first application was a mobile time-clock application, and the second was an expense reporting tool for the purchasing department.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Mr. Gomez co-founded a start-up called Career Disco.

He developed an application that gave users a unique approach to job searching by utilizing their LinkedIn network to find jobs using the power of their network.

The application allowed the user to swipe through their connections and find jobs like their connection within the user’s area. The application connected to LinkedIn’s API via OAuth, and queried jobs from an API developed by Simply Hired.

His main responsibilities included developing responsive user interfaces, back-end services, developing a database, and writing queries.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Mr. Gomez was responsible for the development of several web projects for high-profile clients. He used a combination of Backbone.js and Marionette, .Net, and content management systems to build rich websites and web applications. He worked closely with web designers to build beautiful and user-friendly websites that worked across many web browsers.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Mr. Gomez was responsible for enhancing a PHP back-end system that produced reports in PDF and Excel formats from data stored in a MySQL database. His primary focus during this project was to develop SQL queries to fetch data and write PHP scripts to build dynamic reports. He developed and delivered over 80 new reports during this contract.

company.name: MFactor Meetings - San Francisco Bay Area

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description:
I worked with first-generation college bound students to awaken them to the limitless opportunity and freedom that higher education will provide.

We worked together to plan and reach achievable goals. I also challenge them to reach for higher aspirations.

I feel strongly that everyone should have access to a better life, and to reach it, some people just need a little encouragement and guidance.

positions.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
positions.description: My role included processing all the accounts payable for the company. I had to process the invoices, verify accounts and cost centers, and run the company check run to pay its vendors.

positions.title: Channel Sales Intern
positions.description: I completed a wide range of projects that span from researching international companies with metrics such as vertical industry, growth, revenue, and market reach, to creating Gantt charts to help manage the timing of certain sales-oriented deadlines.
